treatment_plan.definitive: *34,*35,*36Remove the bad restoration and prepare the tooth again and take the impression.
treatment_plan.notes: Chew after 2 hours and do not bite hard objects. Slight swelling and pain in the past few days is normal and should be reviewed on time.

source_handle: *34,*35,*36 Remove the defective restoration and prepare the tooth again and take the impression. Remove the bad restoration, use local infiltration anesthesia with 344% articaine to remove the pulp, clear the root canal, rinse and rinse, try the main tip piece until the root is long, rinse, wipe clean, and fill the root with large taper gutta-percha. The bottom is filled with light-curing resin. 35 Electrosurgery removes excess gum tissue, prepares the post tunnel, and fills with resin. Remove the decay, prepare the hole, and fill it with light-cured resin. 34-36 Abutment tooth preparation, finishing, impression taking, and color comparison. *12, *22 Remove the decay and temporarily seal it with glass ionomer. *32 Alginate impression is taken to make invisible dentures.
